6	embedded as a new "NOTEBOOK" tab. All four source types (PDF/DOCX, audio/video, URLs, vault

# Plan: NotebookLM Clone → Oracle Integration

## Context

Oracle (React 19 + Express/SSE + Ollama + SQLite) needs a non-destructive NotebookLM clone
embedded as a new "NOTEBOOK" tab. All four source types (PDF/DOCX, audio/video, URLs, vault
notes), local-first Whisper transcription, RAG Q&A with streaming citations, auto-generated
documents (PDF export via Puppeteer), data visualizations, and Obsidian NISABA/ sync.

Zero changes to existing Oracle core logic. The integration is purely additive — 3 tiny edits
to existing files + all new files.

---

## Swarm Roles

| Role | Model | Responsibility |
|------|-------|----------------|
| Orchestrator | Opus @ Medium | DB schema, route wiring, integration, final review, swarm state |
| Heavy Lifter | Sonnet @ Max | Complex services (ingest, transcription, RAG, docgen, viz), all React components |
| Background agents | Haiku / local | File reads, research, package docs, preliminary scaffolding |

---

## Phase Sequence

```
Phase 0  → Opus:   notebookSchema.ts + notebookService.ts (unblocks everything)
Phase 1  → Parallel:
            Opus:   notebookRoutes.ts skeleton + 3 existing-file edits
            Sonnet: notebookIngestService.ts + notebookTranscribeService.ts
Phase 2  → Sonnet parallel batch:
            notebookRagService.ts, notebookDocGenService.ts, notebookPdfExportService.ts,
            notebookObsidianSyncService.ts, notebookVizService.ts
Phase 3  → Opus:   wire all services into notebookRoutes.ts
Phase 4  → Sonnet: notebookBridge.ts + all React components
Phase 5  → Both:   integration tests + non-destructive verification
```

---

## Existing Files — 3 Surgical Edits Only

### 1. `src/components/Oracle/OraclePage.tsx`

**Line 36** — extend the `TabId` union:
```typescript
// BEFORE
type TabId = 'context' | 'research' | 'code' | 'visual' | 'ops';
// AFTER
type TabId = 'context' | 'research' | 'code' | 'visual' | 'ops' | 'notebook';
```

**Lines 38–44** — append one entry to the `TABS` array:
```typescript
{ id: 'notebook', label: 'Notebook', icon: '◧' }
```

**Lines 272–275** — extend the render branch (currently a simple ternary):
```typescript
// BEFORE
{activeTab === 'visual' ? (
    <VisualSynthesisLane models={imageModels} />
) : (
    <OracleToolOrbs activeTab={activeTab} />
)}

// AFTER
{activeTab === 'visual' ? (
    <VisualSynthesisLane models={imageModels} />
) : activeTab === 'notebook' ? (
    <NotebookTab />
) : (
    <OracleToolOrbs activeTab={activeTab as Exclude<TabId, 'notebook' | 'visual'>} />
)}
```

Add import at top of file:
```typescript
import NotebookTab from './NotebookTab/NotebookTab';
```

### 2. `backend/src/routes/api.ts`

Insert before `return router;` at line 695 (currently last statement):
```typescript
// Notebook module — additive, no existing routes touched
const { initNotebookRoutes } = require('./notebookRoutes');
initNotebookRoutes(router, db);
```

### 3. `backend/src/models/database.ts`

Insert after `runMigrations(db);` at line 397 inside `initDatabase()`:
```typescript
import { runNotebookMigrations } from './notebookSchema';
// …
runNotebookMigrations(db);   // idempotent — CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pattern
```

## New Files

### Backend

```
backend/src/
  models/
    notebookSchema.ts              ← DDL + runNotebookMigrations() (all CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS)
  services/
    notebookService.ts             ← SQLite CRUD: notebooks, sources, chunks, docs, messages
    notebookIngestService.ts       ← PDF/DOCX/URL/audio/obsidian → chunks → embeddings
    notebookTranscribeService.ts   ← Ollama Whisper first, OpenAI fallback
    notebookRagService.ts          ← retrieval + SSE streaming with citations
    notebookDocGenService.ts       ← summary/FAQ/study_guide/timeline/briefing SSE gen
    notebookPdfExportService.ts    ← Puppeteer HTML→PDF, same branding as Nexus Link template
    notebookObsidianSyncService.ts ← push generated docs to NISABA/09_NOTEBOOK/
    notebookVizService.ts          ← entity freq, temporal, topic graph, sentiment via neuralForge

    notebookRoutes.ts              ← all /api/notebook/* routes

### Frontend

```
src/
  lib/
    notebookBridge.ts              ← API client (mirrors oracleCommandBridge.ts pattern)
  components/Oracle/NotebookTab/
    NotebookTab.tsx                ← two-pane root (280px sources | flex-1 right)
    SourcesPanel.tsx               ← notebook selector + source list
    SourceCard.tsx                 ← type icon + status badge + delete
    SourceUploadZone.tsx           ← drag-drop + URL input + obsidian picker
    ChatPane.tsx                   ← RAG Q&A with SSE, citation pills, reuses oracle-msg CSS
    GeneratedDocsSection.tsx       ← collapsible accordion of DocCards
    DocCard.tsx                    ← doc type badge, markdown preview, PDF export, Obsidian sync
    VizPanel.tsx                   ← tab bar: Entities | Temporal | Topics | Sentiment

---

## DB Schema (5 new tables, `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, no user_version change)

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notebook_notebooks (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Untitled Notebook',
    description TEXT,
    model_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'qwen-liberated:latest',
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notebook_sources (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    notebook_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES notebook_notebooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('pdf','docx','audio','video','url','obsidian')),
    origin_path TEXT,
    obsidian_path TEXT,
    file_size_bytes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    mime_type TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK (status IN ('pending','processing','ready','error')),
    error_msg TEXT,
    word_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    metadata TEXT,   -- JSON: duration, page_count, etc.
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notebook_chunks (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    source_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES notebook_sources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    token_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    embedding TEXT,   -- JSON float[] from neuralForge.getEmbedding('nomic-embed-text')
    metadata TEXT,    -- JSON: page_num, timestamp_start
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notebook_docs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    notebook_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES notebook_notebooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    doc_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (doc_type IN ('summary','study_guide','faq','timeline','briefing')),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    pdf_path TEXT,
    obsidian_path TEXT,
    model_id TEXT,
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notebook_messages (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    notebook_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES notebook_notebooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user','assistant')),
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    sources_used TEXT,   -- JSON: chunk_id[]
    created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
```

---

## API Routes (`/api/notebook/*`)

```
POST   /api/notebook/notebooks                      create notebook
GET    /api/notebook/notebooks                      list all
GET    /api/notebook/notebooks/:id                  get + sources + docs
PATCH  /api/notebook/notebooks/:id                  update title/description
DELETE /api/notebook/notebooks/:id                  cascade delete

POST   /api/notebook/notebooks/:id/sources/upload   multipart file[]
POST   /api/notebook/notebooks/:id/sources/url      { url }
POST   /api/notebook/notebooks/:id/sources/obsidian { vault_path }

GET    /api/notebook/notebooks/:id/viz/entities     EntityFreqData[]

GET    /api/notebook/notebooks/:id/viz/topics       { nodes[], edges[] }
GET    /api/notebook/notebooks/:id/viz/sentiment    SentimentResult
```
